title: Central Tuyuksu · OGGM +1.5°C experiment
source: OGGM 1.6.3, RGI60-13.08624. Illustrative 2020–2100 warming experiment: randomly resampled 1999–2019 W5E5 climate, seed 1, with +1.5°C temperature bias; precipitation unchanged. Initialized from the preprocessed historical spinup. Annual flowline dynamics redistributed to a 2D glacier grid using OGGM; five-year display frames. Bed inferred from OGGM topography and inverted thickness. Not a calibrated local forecast or an SSP projection.
